status: in progress; user requires throughput and memory parity before acceptance
scope: Local Linux loopback. Final throughput comparisons rotate three modes across three fresh-process repetitions per case. Server and every TLS proxy thread share CPUs 0-3; four pinned relay I/O workers; client eight pinned workers on CPUs 8-15. TLS fixture adds one loopback TCP hop and four proxy workers, with both processes included in CPU/RSS. A proxy fixture is not an in-process native WSS implementation. Four-second saturation workloads, 1 KiB application values, 32 private pairs, 1024 room readers with window four. All individual messages, sender, payload, FIFO, exact counters, closure and cleanup checked. Latency histogram percentiles are upper bounds. Event-boundary RSS excludes kernel socket memory and is not continuous peak or total allocation.

diagnostics.excluded_trial: inline-queue initial receiver registered a wakeup even for already queued packets; corrected before the retained candidate. Its final two mixed runs overlapped a correctness test run and are excluded from timing conclusions. No such overlap in the quantum, inline-ready, or final fixed-CPU comparisons.

heap.scope: gperftools replacement allocator, live requested bytes at ready gate with 8192 single-member rooms plus one private pair (8194 sessions). Diagnostic RSS/timing excluded from ordinary performance medians. Frame-pointer build repeats baseline to obtain complete caller stacks.
heap.note: Quinn prepopulates remote stream maps for default 100 bidirectional and 100 unidirectional stream credits; retained task/queue/HTTP3/crypto state adds further cost. No stream limits changed in this candidate.

freshness_scope: 360 offered state updates at 60 Hz for six seconds, 1 KiB each, alongside one reliable 1 MiB bulk value. Independently stamped and validated. Freshest-state probes include the pre-first-update interval at initial state t0. Older datagrams cannot overwrite a newer sequence. Missing datagrams means unreceived within observation window, not an attributed network-loss rate. Netem applies to the external transport port in a temporary isolated namespace, both directions. TLS internal proxy hop is unimpaired. Three clean/loss repetitions for buffered direct stack, one reordering sample per mode; candidate rerun has one sample per mode/profile and is a regression check, not a statistically established loss ranking.
